分析游戏文件，提取文字并处理制作中的技术问题。: Analyze game files, extract text, and handle technical production issues.
按完整场景翻译文字，再用同一模型检查准确性、人物称呼和表达。: Translate text with its scene context, then use the same model to check accuracy, character names, and wording.
填写模型服务的连接信息，设置翻译、校对和成品字体。: Connect your model service and configure translation, proofreading, and output fonts.
API 用于连接模型服务。填写服务商提供的接口地址、模型名称和密钥，使用 Ope: Connect to an OpenAI-compatible model service using the endpoint, model name, and key supplied by your provider. Compatible local model servers can connect in the same way.
先点击“保存设置”，再测试连接。: Save your settings before testing the connection.
连接测试会发送一条简短的模型请求，费用按服务商规则计算。: The test sends a short model request. Your provider may charge for it.
这是所有项目合计的上限，包含游戏文件处理、翻译、校对和图片文字识别（OCR）。: This limit is shared across all projects and includes resource processing, translation, proofreading, and image-text recognition (OCR).
填写希望译成的语言，例如 zh-Hans（简体中文）或 en（英语）。: Enter the language to translate into, such as zh-Hans (Simplified Chinese) or en (English).
技术模型与文字模型默认使用上方的 API 连接。关闭“使用共享连接”可单独设置；: Technical and text models use the shared API connection by default. Turn off "Use shared connection" to configure either separately. Translation and proofreading share the text model.
设置翻译后的校对、失败时的处理方式，以及是否翻译图片文字。: Choose whether to proofread translations, how to handle failures, and whether to process text in images.
自动制作会先完成本轮初翻，汇总译名分歧，再由同一文字模型校对；不另设付费词表整理: Automatic production first completes the translation round, collects naming disagreements, and then uses the same text model to proofread. There is no separate paid glossary-preparation stage.
遇到局部失败时暂停: Pause on a local task failure
开启后，个别任务重试失败会暂停制作；关闭时保留该条当前文字或原图，继续处理其余内: When enabled, a task that still fails after retries pauses production. Otherwise, its current text or original image is kept while other work continues.
识别可处理图片中的文字，再翻译并尝试写回。当前支持平整背景 PNG 的局部文字修: Recognize text in supported images, translate it, and attempt to write it back. Partial edits currently support flat-background PNG images; other images remain unchanged.
所选字体用于生成汉化成品。选择下方字形预览，或使用自己的字体文件。: Use this font in the localized build. Choose a preview below or select your own font file.
选择 TTF 或 OTF 字体: Choose a TTF or OTF font
思源宋体、思源黑体与霞鹜文楷均采用 SIL Open Font License（: Source Han Serif, Source Han Sans, and LXGW WenKai use the SIL Open Font License. The selected bundled font's license is included in the localized build.
点击“保存设置”应用本次修改: Click "Save settings" to apply your changes
填写服务商提供的 API 基础地址，通常以 /v1 结尾。: Enter your provider's API base URL, usually ending in /v1.
填写服务商列出的完整模型名称: Enter the full model name listed by your provider
留空保留已保存密钥，输入新密钥可替换: Leave blank to keep the saved key, or enter a replacement
填写模型服务商提供的 API 密钥: Enter the API key from your model provider
技术、翻译与校对请求使用此容量。留空时使用 32,768 上下文、单次回复至多: Technical, translation, and proofreading requests use these limits. Blank fields use the app defaults: a 32,768-token context and up to 4,096 output tokens per request. Limits are not detected automatically; enter your provider's specifications to use the model's supported capacity.
模型单次能处理的原文、历史和回复总量。: The combined source text, conversation history, and reply the model can process in one request.
按该模型支持的最大输出填写，不是累计使用额度。: Enter the model's supported output limit, not a cumulative usage allowance.
端正文雅，适合叙事与古典氛围。: A refined serif for narrative text and a classical feel.
清晰利落，适合菜单与密集信息。: A clear sans serif for menus and dense information.
自然舒展，适合对白与轻松故事。: A natural handwritten style for dialogue and lighter stories.
打开“设置”，填写模型服务商提供的接口地址、模型名称与 API 密钥。API 用: Open Settings and enter the endpoint, model name, and API key supplied by your model provider. Save your settings, then click "Test saved connection".
把游戏文件夹或启动程序拖入窗口。软件在游戏旁建立“游戏名-拼好工程”，读取原资源: Drag a game folder or executable into the window. Pinhao creates a "game-name-拼好工程" project folder beside the game, reads the original resources, and makes copies as needed. Translations and progress stay in the project; the original game is unchanged.
在“制作总览”点击“开始翻译与校对”：先初翻，再校对，最后生成成品。译名在翻译中: In Overview, click "Start translation & review": translate first, then proofread and build. Name choices accumulate during translation, without preparing a full glossary first. Saved progress lets you pause and continue.
生成后进入“成品与导出”，有启动入口时可直接试玩。检查对话、选项、字体和存档后，: Open Builds & Export after building. Where a launch entry is available, start the game and check dialogue, choices, fonts, and saves before exporting a sharing ZIP. Coverage counts only extracted text, not verification of the entire game.
准备游戏和自己的模型服务，按下面四步制作汉化版。: Bring a game and your own model service. Follow these four steps to make a localized copy.
如需交给外部 AI 或译者处理，在“文字工作台”导出文字工作包，处理后将工作包导: To work with an external AI tool or translator, export a text package from Text Workbench and import the completed package back.
随时点击侧栏“使用教程”重看这份指南。: Open Getting Started in the sidebar to read this guide again.
